info.title: Convinced Campaign API
info.description: Programmatic access to the Convinced campaign system. Create campaigns, push target-company intel, and resolve widget tokens for personalized outreach. The widget loads with `?c=<token>` and grounds the conversation in the intel you supply (or that Convinced synthesizes for you).

servers.description: Public Campaign and Knowledge REST API. SDK prompt administration uses the separate Convinced app origin and ADMIN session authentication.

post.description: Campaigns group target-company rows under a stable slug. Calling this endpoint with an existing slug updates the campaign's name or description; the slug itself is immutable.

403.description: The key scope cannot manage campaigns.

429.description: Per-key hourly quota exceeded. Campaign responses contain an error string without retryAfterSeconds.

post.summary: Create or update a campaign target
post.description: Replace or create one organization-scoped target. A valid supplied intel object takes precedence and skips synthesis. Without intel, enrich defaults true and triggers asynchronous enrichment; false stores a pending row without starting it. Use GET widgetReady before sharing a visitor link. Reusing a token under another campaign moves the existing target to that campaign and replaces its data; it does not return 409. Repeating an upsert can repeat enrichment and does not cancel a running worker.

partnerIntel.description: Use when you already have structured account intel from your CRM or research team.

autoEnrich.description: Send rep notes + landing-page URLs; Convinced synthesizes the intel object.

value.additionalContext: Lead with ROI on dispatch speed; this account misses peak-window SLAs.

403.description: The key scope cannot manage campaigns.

429.description: Per-key hourly quota exceeded. Campaign responses contain an error string without retryAfterSeconds.

get.description: Read target state and widgetReady for either integration mode. widgetReady requires active campaign status, stored intel, and enrichmentStatus done or skipped. This endpoint does not return the full intel object. Use bounded polling and inspect failed or unfinished work before retrying a write.

403.description: The key scope cannot manage campaigns.

404.description: Target not found in this campaign.

429.description: Per-key hourly quota exceeded. Campaign responses contain an error string without retryAfterSeconds.

bearerAuth.description: Partner API key issued from the Convinced dashboard. API keys are organization-bound — never share a key across organizations.

slug.description: Normalized to lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, with repeated hyphens collapsed and output truncated to 64 characters. Derived from name when omitted or blank. Save the returned slug.

description.description: Non-empty trimmed description; omitted or blank input preserves an existing description.

status.description: Status stored on the campaign; only active campaigns are ready for personalization. This endpoint does not change status.

TargetUpsertRequest.description: companyName is required. For partner intel, supply intel and enrich:false. For automatic synthesis, omit intel and supply source material in rawResearch, additionalContext, or links. Valid intel takes precedence if both modes are supplied. Omitted replaceable fields are cleared on an existing target.

companyName.description: Non-empty target company name, used as account context. It does not authenticate a visitor or independently set a saved opening message.

token.description: Organization-scoped identifier, normalized and truncated to 64 characters; derived from companyName when omitted or blank. A repeated token updates and can move the existing target to this campaign.

enrich.description: Expected boolean. When intel is absent, true (default) attempts asynchronous enrichment. False without intel stores a pending row without starting synthesis. Valid supplied intel always skips synthesis.

intel.description: Optional authoritative structured intel. When supplied, the parser validates required fields, normalizes supported fields and skips synthesis. Without it, enrich:false is accepted but leaves an unready row.

rawResearch.description: Optional research notes used for automatic synthesis. Keep inputs concise and the entire encoded JSON body below 1 MiB.
rawResearch.example:
## Account notes
- Mid-market 3PL, last-mile dispatch.
- ~300 drivers, expanding into Tier-2.
- Champion: Priya Rao, VP Ops.

links.description: Strings for link crawling. The API trims strings, discards blank and non-string entries, and retains at most 20; the crawler can process a smaller bounded subset. Input strings are not validated as reachable URLs.

additionalContext.description: Optional context included in auto-enrichment synthesis and research. Stored on the target, but not currently appended verbatim to live session prompts.
additionalContext.example: Lead with ROI on dispatch speed.

CampaignIntel.description: Recognized structured account fields. Unknown fields are ignored, optional invalid values can be dropped, and names are normalized. This schema describes the expected partner-intel input.

companySummary.description: Required non-empty company summary after trimming. Supplies company-profile context; no guarantee of exact agent wording.
companySummary.example: Mid-market 3PL focused on last-mile dispatch for grocery and pharmacy chains across India.

painPoints.description: Required array with at least one non-empty string after normalization. Up to six entries enter session challenges. Phrase problems as account facts.
example: Dispatch decisions are manual and slow during peak windows.

industry.description: Industry or vertical. Used for case-study selection and to calibrate vocabulary.

size.description: Free-form headcount, revenue band, or stage. Calibrates SMB vs. mid-market vs. enterprise positioning.

champion.description: Optional account champion context. Omitted entirely unless both name and role are non-empty strings. This does not establish visitor identity.

context.description: One-line background: priorities, tenure, owned KPIs.
context.example: Owns dispatch SLA and fleet utilization KPIs.

currentStack.description: Tools the prospect ALREADY USES in adjacent or related categories — broader stack, not direct competitors. The agent uses this to talk integrations and avoid suggesting things they have.

recentSignals.description: Recent news or triggers the agent can reference: funding, leadership, launches, expansions.
example: Expanding into Tier-2 cities per Oct earnings call

competitorUsage.description: A SPECIFIC direct competitor the prospect uses today or is evaluating — i.e. someone who does what you do. Sets up switch arguments and head-to-head positioning.
competitorUsage.example: Datadog (incumbent since 2022, evaluating switch due to cost).

relevantCaseStudies.description: Customer names you want the agent to bring up as proof points. Validated against your org's referenceable case studies. Unknown names are dropped silently and surfaced in `response.warnings.droppedCaseStudies`. Match is case-insensitive. Examples use an empty list; supply only real, referenceable customer names from your own organization.

enrichedAt.description: Set when synthesis completed (auto-enrich) or at insertion (partner-intel).

widgetToken.description: The token to pass into the widget.

widgetParam.description: The query parameter name the widget reads from.

widgetQuery.description: Query string containing the normalized target token, for example ?c=acme-logistics.

warnings.description: Present when one or more `relevantCaseStudies` names were dropped because they don't match referenceable customers.

campaignStatus.description: Stored campaign status; only active can produce widgetReady:true.

enrichmentStartedAt.description: Set when enrichment began. Useful for detecting stuck jobs.

hasIntel.description: True when the `intel` object is present on the row.

widgetReady.description: True when the campaign is active, intel is present, and `enrichmentStatus` is `done` or `skipped`. Send the visitor to the widget once this flips to `true`.

EnrichmentStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the auto-enrich pipeline. `pending` (queued), `running` (synthesis in flight), `done` (intel ready), `failed` (synthesis errored), `skipped` (partner-intel mode, no synthesis needed).

error.description: Explanatory error text; do not parse as a stable machine-readable error code.
